_comment: Canonical Hello-BASSM boilerplate. Used by main.js (IDE 'New File' writes `helloWorld` into the scratch project). Plain JSON so CommonJS `require()` from main.js works without interop friction. Snippet content for the website lives in site/src/content/snippets/*.bassm — that is the docs SSOT.
helloWorld:
Graphics 320,256,3
PaletteColor 0,0,0,0
PaletteColor 1,15,15,15

Repeat
    Cls
    Color 1
    Text 100,120,"HELLO BASSM"
    Text 80,140,"PRESS ESC TO EXIT"
    ScreenFlip
Until KeyDown($45)
